newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: BOTSWANAN STOCKS WEEK - BANKS SHARES STRENGTHEN.
newsitem.headline: BOTSWANAN STOCKS WEEK - BANKS SHARES STRENGTHEN.

text.p: Stock Exchange strengthened last week with Barclays traded at
400 thebe, bid up to 405 thebe, First National traded at 465 bid
up to 470 and Standard Chartered at 380 bid up to 385.
Sechaba opened the week and traded unchanged at 245 thebe,
then put on 10 thebe, but later slipped back to 250 thebe.
Losers on the week were Botswana Insurance and Inco, each
down five thebe, and Engen down 10 thebe.
Untraded were Metsef, Pep, Realestate Development and
Volume and turnover were up, with 295,916 (36,200) shares
The index rose 2.5 points to close at 346.62.
